title: G's TV
description: EXPERIMENTAL. Watch a TV channel's picture while parked: by default spelunkr.tv's Toonertia channel (Toonami recordings on the Internet Archive, no DRM, no sign-in), decoded in the app (WebAssembly H.264). Video only, no sound yet. Parked only: the picture shows only while the speed is known and at most 3 km/h and the selector is in P, otherwise 'Video available when parked'. Optional, off by default: Play in cluster, the same picture in the instrument cluster's central map area (between the dials) while parked, removed the moment the car leaves P; needs the separate Cluster renderer tool from the Store. Needs mgu-uplink internet

config.comment: The channel: lineupUrl and channel (spelunkr.tv's lineup), or streamUrl (one https MP4 with H.264 video, looped) instead. <data>/tv.json with the same keys overrides these on the car.
